verdict.rationale: dlt documents a collection of verified sources "developed and maintained by the dlt team and community" (dlt-docs-22). Database coverage is broad: all SQLAlchemy dialects, including Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, SQL Server, DB2, Snowflake, BigQuery and Redshift. File coverage is also broad: JSONL, CSV and Parquet from S3, GCS, Azure, Google Drive, SFTP and local disk. For SaaS APIs it claims 8,000+ or 11,200+ sources, backed by a generic declarative REST API source and an OpenAPI generator. Missing for 10: an enumerated list of prebuilt, maintained SaaS connectors (the large source counts appear to be AI/LLM-assisted scaffolds rather than maintained connectors), evidence of maintenance cadence or quality, and independent hands-on corroboration of catalog breadth.
